entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Magic Tactics Toolbox
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You cause your rivals to spend additional precious resources while wounded.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can curse a creature you’ve dealt damage to since the beginning of your last round to use certain powers quickly. The creature must succeed at a Fortitude save or if it uses any of the following class abilities during the next minute, it must spend at least two daily uses or rounds of that ability: arcane pool, arcane reservoir, bardic performance, bloodrage, bomb, inspiration, ki pool, mental focus, mesmerist trick, phrenic pool, rage, or raging song.

Special: A shaman or witch can use this blood hex as a standard action.
